The synthetic config is the sole retained source-like file; it explicitly identifies synthetic HAVE_INT128 host-fixture configuration.
The unchanged original artifacts.json identifies full-run artifacts, including omitted files; inventory presence does not mean those files are included.
Absolute execution paths, nonces and bindings are preserved without rewriting.
Source manifests retain Spike revision, upstream source URLs, and the original LICENSE identity; upstream source/license bytes remain only in the full temporary run.
No CPU, RISC-V instruction execution, RTL simulation, installed pinned-toolchain qualification, hardware qualification, or G1 acceptance was performed.
This manifest does not hash itself; its exact hash is reported in a50.md.
